data.narrative:
KoBold Metals, a Series C climate and energy company, raised over $1B and carries a current post-money valuation of $3.0B. The valuation universe comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Linamar, LNZA), with key private references including Electric Hydrogen, Amogy, Helion, Redwood Materials, and QuantumScape operating in adjacent stages and sectors.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $3.0B last post-money valuation, implying $5.0B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Redwood Materials ($6.0B, Series D), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B, Series C), and Amogy ($700M, Series C)—yielded a median of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $6.0B.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $5.8B (high), with a median of $3.0B, consistent with the company's stated current valuation. The dispersion reflects material uncertainty around both near-term funding trajectory and comparability of stage/maturity across the peer set. Stage-progression and peer-median methods diverge significantly, suggesting sensitivity to assumption around growth rate and appropriate peer selection within the frontier-energy landscape.
